abort.different_device: The IP address belongs to a different WiZ device.
abort.local_integration_successful: {updated} configured devices now use the security key from the file, and {discovered} new devices were found. Add the new devices from the discovered list now; if any device gets set up without the key, import the file again.

error.bulb_time_out: Cannot connect to the bulb. Maybe the bulb is offline or a wrong IP was entered. Please turn on the light and try again!
error.invalid_local_integration_file: The file is not a valid WiZ local integration export.
error.invalid_signing_key: The security key must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.no_wiz_light: The bulb cannot be connected via WiZ integration.
error.signing_key_with_remove: Leave the security key empty when removing it.

discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} ({host})?

data_description.local_integration_file: In the WiZ app, open the home settings, select Integrations, then Local integrations, and download the file. The download link is only valid for 15 minutes.

local_integration.description: Adds the home security key to the devices of the exported home, and finds devices that are not set up yet.

data_description.signing_key: The home security key from the local integrations export in the WiZ app. Only needed if the home only allows verified controls.

manual.description: If you leave the IP address empty, discovery will be used to find devices.

data_description.remove_signing_key: Send commands unsigned. Only works if the home allows all controls in the WiZ app.

reconfigure.description: Update the IP address or security key of {name}. Leave the security key empty to keep the current one.

menu_options.local_integration: Import the local integration file from the WiZ app
menu_options.manual: Search the network or enter an IP address
